## Figure 7H+I: Preprocessing
```{r}
pdataIO = pdata2[!(is.na(pdata2$CPI_ORR)),]
dataIO = to_DEseq[,!(is.na(pdata2$CPI_ORR))]

pdataIO$library.name == colnames(dataIO)
pdataIO$Pat_ID = paste0('pat_', pdataIO$Pat_ID )
pdataIO$CPI_ORR = sub('0', 'NR', pdataIO$CPI_ORR)
pdataIO$CPI_ORR = sub('1', 'R', pdataIO$CPI_ORR)
library(DESeq2)

pdataIO[,c('Pat_ID', 'CPI_ORR')]
#mat <- dataIO[,-1]
#rownames(mat) <- dataIO[,1]


dds <- DESeqDataSetFromMatrix(countData = dataIO,
                              colData = pdataIO,
                              design= ~ CPI_ORR)

table(pdataIO$CPI_ORR)
smallestGroupSize <- 30 
keep <- rowSums(counts(dds) >= 10) >= smallestGroupSize
dds <- dds[keep,]

dds <- DESeq(dds)
resultsNames(dds) # lists the coefficients

res <- results(dds)

res = data.frame(res)

res = res[order(res$log2FoldChange, decreasing = T),]
res <- rownames_to_column(res, var = "gnames")

res$gnames <- res$...1
res <- res[, -which(names(res) == '...1')]
rownames(res) <- res$gnames

plotd = res
plotd$Selected <- ifelse(res$padj <  0.01 ,"FDR<0.01","FDR>0.01")
plotd$ml10pv = -log(plotd$padj)
rownames(plotd) <- plotd$gnames
```

## Figure 7H: Plotting differentially expressed genes for ICB-response vs no response as Volcanoplot
```{r}
library(ggplot2)
library(ggrepel)
library(EnhancedVolcano)

### Filter here for genes you want to plot
selected_genes_up <- subset(plotd, log2FoldChange > 1 & padj < 0.05)
selected_genes_down <- subset(plotd, log2FoldChange < -1 & padj < 0.05)

Volcano_CPI_ORR <- EnhancedVolcano(plotd,
                lab = rownames(plotd),
                x = 'log2FoldChange',
                y = 'pvalue',
                selectLab = c('IGHG3','CD79A','IGHA1', 'CXCL13','SELL','CD37','CCL21','CXCL9','ITGB2', "CXCL10", 
                              "TCF7", "BATF", "IL10RA", "IRF8", "CD52", "IL16", "JAK3", "TIGIT", "EOMES", "SLAMF7", "B2M",
                              "RAPSN", "NELL1", "CCNA1", "FCGBP", "BCL6B", "ADGRF5", "TOX3", "E2F7", "CDCA8"),
                xlab = bquote(~Log[2]~ 'fold change (R vs NR)'),
                ylab = bquote(~-Log[10]~ 'P (adjusted)'),
                axisLabSize = 18,
                pCutoff = 10e-2,
                FCcutoff = 1.0,
                pointSize = 2.0,
                labSize = 4.0,
                labCol = 'black',
                labFace = 'bold',
                boxedLabels = TRUE,
                colAlpha = 4/5,
                legendPosition = 'top',
                legendLabels = c("FDR>0.05", expression(Log[2] ~ FC >1), "FDR<0.01", expression(FDR <0.01 ~ and
                                                                                      ~ log[2] ~ FC>1)),
                col = c('grey', 'royalblue','orange', 'red'),
                legendLabSize = 14,
                legendIconSize = 4.0,
                drawConnectors = TRUE,
                widthConnectors = 1.0,
                colConnectors = 'black')

Volcano_CPI_ORR
output_dir <- "/Users/maxhaist/Library/CloudStorage/GoogleDrive-mhaist@stanford.edu/.shortcut-targets-by-id/1YzHkXM4dXzuGzyV-ZE_HXBgAGxaMb31Y/MCC_seq_for_Max_Haist/output/CPI_ORR/"
ggsave(plot = Volcano_CPI_ORR, filename = paste0(output_dir, "CPI_R_v_NR_Volcanoplot.pdf"), height = 10, width = 10, dpi = 600)

ggsave('~/Google Drive/My Drive/MCC_seq_for_Max_Haist/bulk_DE/volcano_R_vs_NR.pdf', width = 10,height = 10)
```

## Figure 7I top: GO-enrichment for ICB-response vs no response
```{r}
res_df = as.data.frame(res)
res_df = res_df[complete.cases(res_df),]
res.sort <- res_df[which(res_df$padj < 0.05) ,] 
res.sort = res.sort[res.sort$log2FoldChange > 0.1 | 
                      res.sort$log2FoldChange < -0.1 ,]
res.sort$gnames <- res.sort$gn

to_GSEA_s = data.frame(res.sort)
write.table(to_GSEA_s,paste0("~/Google Drive/My Drive/MCC_seq_for_Max_Haist/bulk_DE/DE_IOresponse_Rtop_NRbottom_FDR_05_LFC_1.txt"),
            quote = F, row.names = F, sep = "\t")

to_GSEA_s <- as.data.frame(to_GSEA_s)
NR_up = as.character(to_GSEA_s[to_GSEA_s$log2FoldChange < 0, "gnames"])
R_up = as.character(to_GSEA_s[to_GSEA_s$log2FoldChange > 0, "gnames"])

to_GO = list(NR_up, R_up) 
names(to_GO) = c("NR_up", "R_up")


library("Rgraphviz")
library("DOSE")
library("clusterProfiler")
library(ggplot2)
library(org.Hs.eg.db)


for(element in names(to_GO)){
  to_GO[[element]] = sub("[.]","-", to_GO[[element]]) 
}

to_GO_EI = list()
for(element in names(to_GO)){
  to_GO_EI[[element]] = bitr(to_GO[[element]], 
                             fromType = "SYMBOL",
                             toType = "ENTREZID",
                             OrgDb = org.Hs.eg.db)
}

length(complete.cases(to_GO$R_up))

keytypes(org.Hs.eg.db)

###run GO analysis, I am running ont= BP (biological processes) /MF/CC
GO_res = list()
for(element in names(to_GO)){
  GO_res[[element]] = enrichGO(gene         = to_GO_EI[[element]]$ENTREZID,
                               OrgDb         = org.Hs.eg.db,
                               ont           = "BP",
                               pAdjustMethod = "BH", pvalueCutoff = 0.01,
                               qvalueCutoff  = 0.05,
                               readable = TRUE)
}


for(element in names(GO_res)){
  png(paste0(path,"/",element,".png"), width = 900, height = 1100)
  plot(dotplot(GO_res[[element]],showCategory=50)+ labs(title= element))
  dev.off()
}

res = list()
for(element in names(GO_res)){
  if(nrow(GO_res[[element]]@result) == 0){
    next
  }
  res[[element]] = GO_res[[element]]@result[,c("ID","p.adjust", "Description","geneID","GeneRatio")]
}

dim(res$R_up)

for(element in names(res)){
  res[[element]] = res[[element]][res[[element]]$p.adjust <= 0.05,]
}

dim(res$NR_up)


for(element in names(res)){
  write.table(res[[element]], paste0("~/Google Drive/My Drive/MCC_seq_for_Max_Haist/bulk_DE/",element,".txt"), sep = "\t", row.names = F)
}

GO_NR <- GO_res$NR_up
GO_R <- GO_res$R_up

dotplot(GO_R, showCategory=30) + ggtitle("dotplot for GSEA")


edox <- setReadable(GO_R, 'org.Hs.eg.db', 'ENTREZID')
p1 <- cnetplot(edox, foldChange=R_up)
p1 <- heatplot(edox, showCategory=5)
p1

p1 <- heatplot(edox, showCategory=5)
```

## Figure 7I bottom: PCA scores for ICB-response vs ICB-no-response
```{r}
pdata = read.csv("/Users/maxhaist/Library/CloudStorage/GoogleDrive-mhaist@stanford.edu/.shortcut-targets-by-id/1YzHkXM4dXzuGzyV-ZE_HXBgAGxaMb31Y/MCC_seq_for_Max_Haist/sorted_pdata_MCC.csv")
data = read.csv("/Users/maxhaist/Library/CloudStorage/GoogleDrive-mhaist@stanford.edu/.shortcut-targets-by-id/1YzHkXM4dXzuGzyV-ZE_HXBgAGxaMb31Y/MCC_seq_for_Max_Haist/sorted_counts_MCC.csv", row.names = 1)

pdata$library.name == colnames(data)

dataIO = data[,!(is.na(pdata$CPI_ORR))]
pdataIO = pdata[!(is.na(pdata$CPI_ORR)),]

pdataIO$CPI_ORR

phenotypes = read.csv("/Users/maxhaist/Nolan Lab Dropbox/Maximilian Haist/MCC_project/scripts/LCMseq_analysis/Phenotypes_scores_list.csv",header = T)
phenotypes[phenotypes == ""] = NA 
phenotypes = as.list(phenotypes, na.rm = T)
phenotypes = lapply(phenotypes, na.omit)
phenotypes = lapply(phenotypes, toupper)

library(ggplot2)
library(ggpubr)

##plot all plots
my_comparisons <- list( c("0", "1"))

setwd("/Users/maxhaist/Library/CloudStorage/GoogleDrive-mhaist@stanford.edu/.shortcut-targets-by-id/1YzHkXM4dXzuGzyV-ZE_HXBgAGxaMb31Y/MCC_seq_for_Max_Haist/output/scores/CPI_ORR/")
res = data.frame(patient = pdataIO$Pat_ID, type = pdataIO$CPI_ORR)

### Boxplots with stats corrected for multiple testing
for(element in names(phenotypes)){
  to_PCA = dataIO[rownames(dataIO) %in% phenotypes[[element]],]
  to_PCA = log2(t(to_PCA+1))
  PCA = prcomp(to_PCA,scale. = T)
  coeff[[element]] = PCA$rotation
  res[[element]] = PCA$x[,1]
  
  to_plot = data.frame(type = pdataIO$CPI_ORR,
                       PC1_scores = PCA$x[,1])
  
  to_plot$type = factor(to_plot$type)
  
  stat.test <- to_plot %>%
    t_test(as.formula(paste0("PC1_scores", " ~ ", "type"))) %>%
    adjust_pvalue(method = "bonferroni") %>%
    add_significance() %>%
    add_xy_position(x = "type")
  
  # Print the results of the statistical test
  stat.test
  
  colors <- c("#FF6A15", "#00B45C")
  # Create a box plot with jittered points for each column in "cols"
  to_plot %>%
    ggplot() +
    aes_string(x = "type", y = "PC1_scores") +
    stat_boxplot(geom = "errorbar", linetype = 1, width = 0.03, lwd = 0.7, color = "#333333") +
    geom_boxplot(outlier.shape = NA, fill = colors, width = 0.4, lwd = 1) +
    geom_point(colour = "black", fill = "white", size = 1.6, position = position_jitter(w = 0.18, h = 0), shape = 21, stroke = 1.0) +
    labs(y = paste0(element, " percentage"), title = element) +
    ggprism::theme_prism() +
    xlab("ICB.response")+
    scale_x_discrete(labels = c("NR", "R")) +
    stat_pvalue_manual(stat.test,
                       label = "p.adj",
                       label.size = 5,
                       fontface = "italic",
                       bracket.size = 1)
  ggsave(paste0('PCA_score_',element,'.pdf'), width = 4, height = 5, dpi = 300)
}
```
